# Product finding: an ambiguous wikilink keeps one of its candidate targets out
# of the orphan report. `[[shared-name]]` is ambiguous between
# kb/notes/alpha/shared-name.md and kb/notes/beta/shared-name.md, but
# `akb orphans` reports only kb/notes/beta/shared-name.md (plus the source
# page, which nothing links to) — alpha/shared-name.md is not reported even
# though no page resolves to it unambiguously.

exec akb init link-orphan-kb
cd link-orphan-kb

stdin ../alpha-note.md
exec akb write alpha/shared-name.md

stdin ../beta-note.md
exec akb write beta/shared-name.md

stdin ../source-note.md
exec akb write source-note.md

skip 'product-finding: ambiguous wikilink suppresses the orphan report for one candidate target (expected alpha+beta, got beta+source)'

# exec akb orphans
# stdout 'notes/alpha/shared-name.md'
# stdout 'notes/beta/shared-name.md'

-- alpha-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Alpha Note
summary: First note
tags: linktest
---
Alpha content with [[shared-name]].

-- beta-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Beta Note
summary: Second note
tags: linktest
---
Beta content with [[shared-name]].

-- source-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Source Note
summary: Links to ambiguous target
tags: linktest
---
This links to [[shared-name]] and [[nonexistent-page]].
